issues.quote: He tells each owner what is wrong with it.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says only that Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine when the bell struck nine. It says nothing about any watch being inaccurate.
issues.misreading: A solver could take this, along with 'a watch either keeps the time or it does not', to mean the watches are known to be faulty, so Félix's 8:40 reading might not be trustworthy. That casts doubt on a reading the sheet gives as plain fact.
